name_zh: 卡德纳斯/墨西哥/石油/国有化/土地/革命/拉萨罗/PEMEX/埃希多
core_mode: M603 石油国有化/土地革命/卡德纳斯主义/PEMEX/革命制度化
description_zh: 拉萨罗·卡德纳斯（1895-1970），墨西哥前总统，1934-1940年在位。他是一位墨西哥政治家，前陆军将领，通过"石油国有化"政策，将外国石油公司驱逐出境，建立了PEMEX石油公司，实现了墨西哥的石油独立。他实施了土地改革，分配土地给农民，推动了墨西哥革命制度化建设。他的统治时期，墨西哥实现了经济独立和民族主义复兴。
description_en: Lázaro Cárdenas (1895-1970), former President of Mexico, served from 1934 to 1940. He was a Mexican politician and former military officer, implemented the "oil nationalization" policy, expelled foreign oil companies, established PEMEX oil company, achieved Mexico's oil independence. He implemented land reform, distributed land to peasants, promoted Mexican revolutionary institutionalization. His rule period saw Mexico's economic independence and nationalist revival.
reason_zh: 卡德纳斯通过石油国有化政策实现了墨西哥的石油独立，建立了PEMEX石油公司，推动了土地革命和革命制度化建设。他的统治实现了墨西哥的经济独立和民族主义复兴，体现了后殖民时期的自主发展精神。
reason_en: Cárdenas achieved Mexico's oil independence through nationalization policy, established PEMEX oil company, promoted land revolution and revolutionary institutionalization. His rule saw Mexico's economic independence and nationalist revival, exemplified post-colonial autonomous development.
